rows.about: Text that the author writes but that the diagram does not re

judgment.note: None of the named syntax and tree documents defines authored diagram text that mermaid.js does not read and that has no effect. Ishikawa reads accDescr {} as ordinary node text (diagrams/ishikawa.md, A node). Kanban reads class-text as a lexical unit and each class line decorates the last node (diagrams/kanban.md, The icon and class contexts; Icons and classes): ast/kanban.md, KanbanNode, saying "Classes that the Db does not expose also remain in the list" does not say that its text is unread. Mindmap reads node, shape and decoration text as units. Sankey reads record fields, including empty fields. Treemap reads an empty description block as a common statement (diagrams/treemap.md, Common statements; ast/treemap.md, TreemapAccDescrBlockStatement); usecase similarly calls it a normal statement (ast/usecase.md, UsecaseAccDescrBlockStatement). Their lexers read the block delimiters, unlike the tokenless empty blocks of the six rejudged diagrams. ErrorDiagram has no child fields or other fields. Shared trivia are root records or tokens, not a retained unread diagram leaf.
